1606 is a common year (not divisible by 4).  
184 days before July 15, 1606:  
Back 184 days = back 31 (Jan) + 28 (Feb) + 31 (Mar) + 30 (Apr) + 31 (May) + 30 (Jun) + 3 (July partial) = 184 days.  
July 15 minus 3 days → July 12.  
July 12 minus June (30) → June 12.  
June 12 minus May (31) → May 12.  
May 12 minus Apr (30) → Apr 12.  
Apr 12 minus Mar (31) → Mar 12.  
Mar 12 minus Feb (28) → Feb 12.  
Feb 12 minus Jan (31) → Jan 12 of 1606.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1606-01-12
